shapes.text:
R0 baselines
rules, zero return, trailing events, empirical distributions

R1 regularised
ridge for returns, logistic for events; fold-local transforms, matured labels

R2 challengers
histogram gradient boosting: return, quantile, event; must beat the baseline
Walk-forward folds with a purge and embargo sized to the horizon. Every transform, imputer and calibrator is fitted inside its training fold. A challenger goes to shadow, then to you.

shapes.text: Rules. Every figure Claude uses comes from a versioned tool result. Claude never produces a forecast number, writes the ledger, promotes a model or trades. shapes.text: ARC-02 and ARC-03 with policies 001, 005 and 007. An extraction is a draft until you approve the exact change; one controlled writer commits it. Steps are numbered in time order.

1 Choose a statement
CSV, Excel, PDF, screenshot or manual

6 Extract
Haiku 5.5; draft rows with page and row evidence

7 Validate and propose
reconcile, find duplicates, form complete groups

8 Preview
exact proposal: included and excluded entries

9 Approve groups
fresh sign-in; exact content and hash

10 Start the commit
within 15 min; rechecks hash, version, expiry

11 Commit and audit
new ledger version; idempotent; approval kept

12 Re-read
SSE notice, then a fresh read

Unresolved entries
stay pending and visible; never dropped

15-minute window
from approval to the start of the commit

Rules. A changed subset or changed content needs a fresh proposal and a fresh approval; an expired approval must be renewed before the commit starts. Dependent entries (cash, fees) stay together in their group. Holdings count from the trade date, with settlement tracked separately. S3 and DynamoDB share no transaction, so the commit is idempotent and resumable.

Separation. Dev agents, synthetic imports, tests and CI have no routine write access to prod; each account has its own identities, deployment roles and write authority. Cost. £100 a month all-in across both accounts, market data and Claude: £70 of operation and a £30 reserve; warn at £60, reduce optional work at £75, pause it at £85. Region. Virginia (us-east-1), owner-selected 2 November 2026.

Every record carries its source, timestamps and a version. Append-only: a correction is a new version and an outcome is a new record. DynamoDB keys and indexes are not chosen; these are logical records.

Reading it. PK is the record's key, FK points at another record. Crow's feet mark the many side. Colours: teal ledger, amber market data, purple forecasting, rose research, grey operations. An event analysis reaches a forecast only as a structured, point-in-time input, and only after it has shown it adds accuracy.
